translations.answer: Compare mass, COM, and inertia (including off-diagonal terms) in SolidWorks quality assessment, verify joint axes/coordinate systems, effort (Nm) and velocity (rad/s); simplify collision geometry without altering visual or inertial data. The list does not include tolerance; define it based on platform measurement precision.
translations.applicability: Personal experience; closed-chain structure still needs to be constrained in the target simulation environment.
translations.credibility.rationale: Environmental, processing steps, and results have engineering records, but formal data cross-validation or independent replication is missing.
translations.details.attempts.0: Manually fill inertial fields, verify total mass, joint coordinate systems and limits, simplify collision geometry, and visualize using MuJoCo/RViz.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Cross-verified by text, visible comments, and media; not independently validated by paper, source code, or official documentation.
translations.details.environments.0: SolidWorks assembly → URDF → MuJoCo/Isaac Sim; RViz/VS Code checks.
translations.details.limits.0: Personal experience; closed-chain structure still needs to be constrained in the target simulation environment.
translations.details.outcomes.0: Form a post-export acceptance list; no quantitative error threshold defined.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: CAD to URDF simulation is functional, but the strategy deviates in real machine; which mechanical quantities should be verified first?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Community candidates are only for hypothesis formation; when involving real machines, limit speed, force, and isolate personnel while retaining logs.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: Inaccurate export of mass, center of mass, and inertia (including off-diagonal terms), incorrect inertia term signs, excessive mesh faces or overly detailed collision geometry.
translations.details.symptoms.0: Strategy deviates in real machine, simulation loading failure or slowdown, incorrect joint direction or limits.
translations.media_summaries.0: No visible media found; mass, inertia, and collision experience are fully verified from text, but no claim of seeing images.
